meanings.note: Privative prefix 'бес-' ('without, -less', before voiceless consonants) (stem 'иться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'was furious, raged'.
